Delhi Police Tightens Security Ahead of Opposition Party's Parliament March

Delhi Police has increased security measures, including extensive barricading and 24-hour surveillance, in anticipation of a planned 'Chalo Sansad' march by the Kokroach Janata Party. The march is scheduled for July 20, coinciding with the monsoon session of Parliament. Police have stated that permission for the march has not been obtained, and authorities are conducting thorough checks of vehicles and deploying additional forces in key areas.
